description: Create a payment intent to charge a customer. Use this to initiate a one-time payment for a specified amount and currency before confirming or capturing it.

amount.description: Amount in the smallest currency unit (e.g. cents)

description: Create a new customer record on the payment platform. Use this when onboarding a new payer so future invoices, subscriptions, and charges can be tied to a single identity.
List recent payment charges, optionally filtered by customer or date range. Use this when the user wants a transaction history or to reconcile payments.
Refund a previous charge in full or in part. Use this when the user wants to return money to a payer for a refunded order or disputed transaction.

amount.description: Partial refund amount in cents; omit for full refund

description: Subscribe a customer to a recurring price plan. Use this when starting a new monthly or annual subscription for an existing customer.
Cancel an active subscription, either immediately or at the end of the current period. Use this when a customer requests to stop recurring billing.

at_period_end.description: If true, cancel at end of current billing period

description: Create a new invoice for a customer with line items. Use this when billing a customer for completed work, products delivered, or services rendered.

items.description: Line items with name, quantity, price

description: Email an invoice to the customer. Use this after creating an invoice when the user wants to actually deliver it to the payer.
Mark an invoice as paid, recording the payment amount and method. Use this when payment was received outside the platform and you need to reconcile the invoice status.
List invoices, optionally filtered by status (draft, sent, paid, overdue). Use this when the user wants an overview of receivables or to find invoices in a particular state.
Get the current balance sheet for a given reporting period. Use this when the user asks about the company's financial position, assets, or liabilities.
Generate a profit-and-loss report for a date range. Use this when the user asks about revenue, expenses, or net income over a period.

Update an existing contact's fields such as phone, address, or custom properties. Use this when enriching or correcting contact data.
